grades: Sophomores, juniors and seniors in fall 2026
name: Driehaus Summer Business Institute
org: DePaul University, Driehaus College of Business
what_you_do: Take a one-week class with team projects in money, sales, business and accounting. You pitch a new idea for a business. You earn a business certificate.
who_can_apply: Current high school students who will be sophomores, juniors or seniors in fall 2026.
pay_detail: $1,000. A 10% discount is offered for the high schooler of DePaul alumni.
duration: One week, 27.5 hours of classes plus 5 hours of site visits
deadline_text: 2027 information will be posted later. No deadline is listed. Late sign-ups go on a waitlist.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply link on the program page. Questions: admission@depaul.edu or (312) 362-8000, or dsbi@depaul.edu for alumni discounts. Classes are capped at 20 students.
notes: Costs money. The page does not say if it is a live-in program and no scholarships are mentioned.
